correctness.rationale: Radial Bloch value and derivative estimates are saturated simultaneously by the normalized arctanh test along positive real radii. Differentiating the rational weighted composition yields exact positive A and K coefficients. The constant-coordinate coefficient is bounded by the reciprocal moment; Fatou at the boundary forces the arctanh derivative component to dominate. The uniform K≤3/t bound justifies all integrals. The atomic change of variable is algebraically checked, and εlog(1/ε) establishes strict gap. The semigroup identity plus uniform limiting scalar profile independently gives the spectral radius. Endpoints t=1 and zero measures are checked. No unproved infinite-dimensional step is based on a numerical test.

value.rationale: This calculates the exact operator norm for an entire natural positive measure cone, not merely a chosen slice, and provides one universal norming function despite continuously varying measures. Prior work emphasizes spectra, which only give norm lower bounds; strict separation and sharp asymptotic ratio supply quantitative nonnormality. The exact measure formula is usable for evaluating bounded Hausdorff averages and testing norm growth, and the limiting constant reflects a nontrivial interior radial boundary layer.
